reviews.text: Лучший трекер. Решила бросить курить, скачала все возможные трекеры для отслеживание прогресса и мотивации. Этот самый лучший и информативный даже в бесплатной версии. Еще и ачивки есть! Не курю уже больше недели)

Perfect App. Really Helpful Tool that tracks the time you’ve quit, the money you’ve saved and the health benefits you’ve reaped. You have the choice to use it to access support if you choose to do so. I gave up smoking 1 year, 3 months and 13 days ago and saved $4734.30. I know this because I still visit the app from time to time! Highly recommended app!
Keep Checking Back. Love that I can always go back and see my progress. 5 months in it still helps some days to see how far I have come.

Doing it for good. Before I downloaded this app, I read, or listened to, Allen Carr’s Easy Way. Highly recommend. Listening to this book helped to set a foundation for me holding myself accountable this time. The day before I was due to stop, I downloaded the app and “explored” everything. Having missions to look forward to and accomplish, helps. The app also gives me something to do while keeping my mindset on track with quitting. This is totally possible. Once one can understand just how much benefit (none) smoking brings a person, your mindset about smoking will start to change. It’s not easy, but I’m also finding this time to be easier than the last several times. I’ve got support, I’ve got resources and I get daily “pats on the back” for sticking to it.

Great app! Very helpful. Thanks for providing a great app and service to help people like me overcome the challenges of quitting smoking. I appreciate that the app has a lot of features at the free level and doesn’t force me to subscribe. However I would see a benefit in doing so if I could afford a subscription.

Helpful app. The app is a helpful tool if you Lao have your mind set for the most part. It helps keep you accountable. Everyday it helps you see how far you’ve come in many areas. I enjoy opening the app everyday I wake up and seeing how far I’ve finally come. I highly recommend this app if you’re quitting smoking.
Money money money. Love seeing it and feeling great

A lot of the features feel half baked/non-functional. I don’t *actually* care about the Inner Dragon thing beyond engaging with it as a joke, but there doesn’t seem to be a way to increase the energy stat? Has just dropped to 0 and stayed there no matter what I do. 

Unless it’s tied to the mushroom memory game, but that game honestly isn’t fun and takes way too long.
Amazing service. Love using this app to help keep me motivated and proud of myself, even with the “set backs.”
pointless give both options. another app only to help cigarette smokers stop, not vaping.

This app has been so helpful in having a visual tracker of how many days that I had been quit and how much money I have saved. I really love it!

Incredibly helpful to quit vaping/smoking. I NEVER write app reviews, but this one is too special and has helped so many people I have to. I used this app to quit vaping in 2022 and didn’t vape for 6 months! Fell off and am attempting to quit again and today I got my 4 day badge of being smoke free! I quit cold turkey and anytime I get a craving I look at the health improvements and it gives me SO much motivation to not break my quit date. To quit smoking/vaping you have to want to do it and it is on you to quit, however we all have our weak moments so opening the smoke free app and seeing how long it’s been since I last vaped, how much money I’ve saved, and how my health has improved inspires me to stay on the right path and reminds me how much better I feel when I have conquered my addiction to vaping. The notifications are not too often, just enough to remind me I’m doing great. Bless everyone going through this journey to live smoke free ❤️

If you connect to the coach, instead of picking up a cigarette, you're that much closer to one of the greatest accomplishments you'll ever achieve. I'm super proud of myself. Thank you ”Smoke-Free”!

It’s a great tracker if smoke free days. I love being able to track my status of not smoking with increased health achievements, money saves, and best of all, how long (to the hour) I’ve been smoke free!

Alright smoking tracker. got this app a few months ago over the summer because my throat started persistently hurting as a result of smoking. It was pretty helpful at first, but I think in hindsight a lot of my smoking issues began when I started seeing this guy on Hinge. We would sit on the roof of his apartment complex and chainsmoke while exchanging music and watching cars. We burned through at least five cigarettes on our first coffee date, but it felt natural. I think I was all but blinded by his heeled boots and tight, cropped shirts, because I realize now my existence was nothing more than an aesthetic choice to him. Someone to tote around to ensure that others knew he was worth something to someone in the face of trying to discover himself. In constant search of selfhood but consistently falling short because filling the gaps with another insecure college student just changes the problem into one that involves two people. I don't think im much better though because I let it happen. I was also desperately searching for my own validation, looking for someone to affirm my immature choices. I didn't think a two month situationship could do this kind of psychic damage, but I don't know what I expected. Anyway, I still smoke every day and my throat still hurts, and I like to think it's partially the app's fault because it makes me feel better about myself.

Do not recommend. Reply to developer: There was no warning. There was no mis information. I posted factual articles written by doctors and scientists. The goal of quitting smoking is to be healthy. You are still a smoker if you are smoking vapes. If the intent of the group is quit smoking cigarettes only it should be made clear. Either way just because someone does actually research and feels different than the developer they should not be kicked out of a support group. I’d recommend finding a different app. 
Oh weird but yes you are right no hot oil hot vegetable glycerin. Which is used in moisturizers and candles. When heated up produces formaldehyde and acetaldehyde. So go ahead keep pushing people to use vapes and calling it safe 🙄

They have a group that goes along with this app. I was kicked out for disagreeing with them. They push that you should use vapes to quit. I pointed out multiple findings and studies that say they are finding that it may actually be worse than cigarettes. They are finding young males especially are dropping like flies due to vapes. Point being of this review, if you have a support group you support people in their journey. Even if their views don’t align with yours. Cold turkey after 14 years. I was a 14 year smoker who smoked about a pack a day… and I haven’t had a single drag since downloading Smoke Free. However, this wasn’t just the app. 

Having a real life accountability buddy was everything (however, I did join this app prior to any chat/Ai being super prevalent). The app gamified things which was certainly a motivator! I am also a person who appreciates data and trackable progress, so being able to quantify the changes to my habit was very cool. 

The financial tracking aspect (most of the tracking, really) was as jarring as it was rewarding. This was a fun party trick to show friends to encourage them to become quitters as well. 

If I were at then beginning of my journey, I would want this to be more like Duolingo where I am really able to engage in something besides smoking (rather than just journal about it). 

But ultimately, thank you. Finally deleting this app after 5 years. I appreciate all you’ve done/tracked for me <3
